description: From a year and month on, the Zusammenfassende Meldung is filed in this rhythm until the next rule.

fields.description: Monthly from any month, quarterly from month 1, 4, 7 or 10, yearly from January.

fields.description: Only for monthly filing, after the Anzeige of § 18a Absatz 3 UStG: the sonstige Leistungen go into the ZM of their month instead of that of the last month of the quarter.
fields.label: Sonstige Leistungen Monthly
